alate: Head deep brownish yellow, the antennae, postclypeus, thorax, abdomen and wings paler than the head, the venter of the abdomen palest. The whole body densely haired, the wing surface hairless. Head broadly oval; compound eyes rather large, ocelli small and elongate-oval, very close to the compound eyes; fontanelle in the centre of the vertex, a longitudinal bar-shaped depressed spot; postclypeus very highly raised, the anterior margin straight, the posterior margin semicircular, the length about half the width. Antennae 15-segmented, segments 2 and 3 about equal in length, or segment 2 longer than segment 3, segments 2 and 4 nearly equal. Anterior lateral angles of the pronotum projecting forward, the posterior lateral angles broadly rounded, the anterior margin shallowly concave, the posterior margin concave at the centre. Forewing with the radial sector running close to the anterior margin to the wing apex, the media arising independently at the humeral suture, nearer the cubitus than the radial sector, reaching the wing apex with slight branching, the cubitus with about 12 branches; hindwing with the media arising from the base of the radial sector, the other veins as in the forewing.
distribution: Jinghong, Yunnan, altitude 500 m; also recorded abroad in Myanmar.
soldier: Head like a rectangular tube, the lateral margins slightly straight, the posterior lateral angles slightly rounded, the posterior margin slightly curved backwards, the anterior end truncate. The frontal prominence very conspicuous, thick and broad at the base, pointed and rounded at the apex and directed forward and upward; in lateral view this prominence first extends forward and then turns upward. Mandibles symmetrical, slender like pincers, the anterior ends slender and flattened, hooked towards the midline; in lateral view the mandibles first extend forward and upward and then curve downwards, like a bent stick. The inner margin of each mandible bears a small tooth at one-eighth of its posterior section, the tooth apex blunt; behind the small tooth of the left mandible there is a large tooth-like process with a rounded, blunt apex. Labrum subrectangular, the two anterior lateral angles drawn out into needle-like points. Antennae 14-segmented, segments 2 and 3 equal in length, segment 4 shortest or equal in length to segment 2.
